profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Cash App
profile.summary:
I love to tackle hard problems.  I am known for designing and delivering features that were once considered impossible - where many had tried before and came up short.  I am driven by user experiences and customer satisfaction.

I have a history if success on multiple platforms and languages including C++, C#, Java, and Kotlin.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Tech Lead
- Building shared Frameworks serving multiple organizations. 
- Champion of Architecture, DevEx, and OpEx
- Leveraging AI to accelerate outcomes.

positions.title: Principal Architect
positions.description: Building search and intelligence in the M365 ecosystem

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on Federated ML infrastructure.
https://federated.withgoogle.com/

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on expanding Cortana to new user experiences and devices, including the Harman Kardon Invoke.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on building the first version of Cortana on Android and Windows 10.  Additionally I worked on expanding cross platform capabilities of Cortana and enabling new Cortana experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on the Windows Internet Explorer team developing new features and maintaining legacy code for Windows HTTP stacks: WinHttp and WinINet.  My primary areas of focus are improving Web Proxy performance in Windows and delivering new features for emerging Windows/Internet scenarios.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Converted the Microsoft Component Services MMC Snap-In from C++ to C#.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Built an employee database and ASP.NET front-end for the company intranet.  
Implemented a web app to retrieve patent applications from the U.S. Patent Office and combine them into a single PDF.
